description: This Java class defines the 'Note' entity for a notes application, including fields for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and includes lifecycle callbacks to manage timestamps.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note with fields for ID, title, content, creation, and update timestamps, including lifecycle hooks for timestamp management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to set createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the updatedAt timestamp before updating.
